curation_strategy: Arc obligations were satisfied first—six passages for Richard's deterioration tracing his arc from Esther's early character sketch through obsession to physical ruin, five for Lady Dedlock's secret from the Hawdon handwriting shock to burial, and four for Jo's suffering from the 'moved on' testimony to the death-cart. Expert assignments were then matched to each panel member's strongest dimensional demands: Daniel Rosen receives social-critique heavy passages on Chancery's material damage; Eleanor Hartley receives narrative-technique and character-development passages centred on Esther's dual vision and Richard's psychological tragedy; Oliver Trevelyan receives high-entertainment, high-atmosphere passages suited to performance. Structure passages were chosen to fill the four plot-advancement and three thematic-depth gaps identified in the episode, prioritising passages with high interest scores and cross-chapter diversity, avoiding any segment exceeding its maximum passage count.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the Machine: Dickens' Opening Gambit
curation_assignments.rationale: The iconic fog-everywhere opening establishes Dickens' atmospheric genius and gives Oliver vivid material for performance and wit.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the Machine: Dickens' Opening Gambit
curation_assignments.rationale: The primordial mud-and-fog opening paragraph is maximally quotable and showcases Dickens' satirical Gothic voice for a performer.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the Machine: Dickens' Opening Gambit
curation_assignments.rationale: The satirical Chancery tableau—Chancellor swathed in fog, lawyers processing technicalities—is rich in comic excess and polemical energy.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Chancellery Grinds: Class, Law, and Extraction
curation_assignments.rationale: The direct indictment of Chancery as pestilent and sinful is the central social-critique passage for Daniel's Marxist reading.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Chancellery Grinds: Class, Law, and Extraction
curation_assignments.rationale: Jarndyce's tour of decayed property legally consumed by costs is a perfect materialist exhibit of how the law extracts from the poor.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Chancellery Grinds: Class, Law, and Extraction
curation_assignments.rationale: The journey through dark streets to the rag-and-bottle shop maps class geography and the forensic obstruction of ordinary life.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Chancellery Grinds: Class, Law, and Extraction
curation_assignments.rationale: Jo's account of being repeatedly 'moved on' with nowhere to go is a harrowing exhibit of systemic persecution of the poor.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's Voice and Silence: The Cost of Being Unseen
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's meditation on Jo's exclusion from literacy and human dignity is the novel's most powerful statement of his suffering.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's Voice and Silence: The Cost of Being Unseen
curation_assignments.rationale: Dickens' scathing indictment of society treating Jo as less worthy than a 'foreign savage' is a defining moment of social critique and dark wit.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's Voice and Silence: The Cost of Being Unseen
curation_assignments.rationale: Jo's dialect speech about being 'chivied' to skin and bones voices his suffering directly, combining social critique with narrative technique.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's analysis of how injustice breeds injustice in Richard is the thematic and psychological core of his deterioration arc.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's reflection on Richard's false hopefulness as more painful than despair is a peak of character-psychological analysis.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: The 'ruin of youth' passage captures Richard's physical and moral collapse in language that rewards Eleanor's literary-critical close reading.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's early assessment of Richard's talented but undisciplined character establishes the baseline from which his deterioration is measured.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: Richard's fierce declaration of commitment to the suit reveals the obsessive self-delusion driving his downfall.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: Richard's confession to Woodcourt that he has accomplished nothing and feels trapped is a pivotal moment of psychological exposure.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: Woodcourt finding Richard haggard and lost in thought rather than working gives a vivid external view of his psychological collapse.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Compass: Tracing a Gentleman's Ruin
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther seeing Richard physically wasted on his deathbed—'how worn away he was'—is the final station of his deterioration arc.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Esther's Double Vision: The Dual Narration at Work
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's analysis of her uncanny emotional response to Lady Dedlock's face is a masterclass in the first-person narrator withholding what she almost knows.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Esther's Double Vision: The Dual Narration at Work
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's comic-tender reproach of her own disfigured reflection illustrates how the dual narration performs self-examination with layered irony.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Esther's Double Vision: The Dual Narration at Work
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's response to Lady Dedlock's voice deepens the dual-narration theme by showing how emotional knowledge precedes conscious recognition.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Grotesques Speak: Krook, Smallweed, Chadband, and the Art of Comic Excess
curation_assignments.rationale: Krook's self-identification with the Lord Chancellor—'We both grub on in a muddle'—is the novel's most comic grotesque moment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Grotesques Speak: Krook, Smallweed, Chadband, and the Art of Comic Excess
curation_assignments.rationale: Vholes's noxious office description is a sustained exercise in Gothic-satirical comic excess that rewards performative reading.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Grotesques Speak: Krook, Smallweed, Chadband, and the Art of Comic Excess
curation_assignments.rationale: The court's obsessive gossip about Smallweed's treasure hunt is riotously comic and satirically sharp about collective fantasy.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Grotesques Speak: Krook, Smallweed, Chadband, and the Art of Comic Excess
curation_assignments.rationale: The sensationalist newspaper reporters interviewing court residents after Krook's death is pure comic grotesque with thematic depth about media and spectacle.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Secret and the System: Lady Dedlock's Impossible Position
curation_assignments.rationale: The cat-and-mouse social performance between Lady Dedlock and Tulkinghorn dramatizes how class and legal power trap aristocratic women.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Secret and the System: Lady Dedlock's Impossible Position
curation_assignments.rationale: The collapse of Lady Dedlock's facade—'All is broken down'—is the pivotal plot revelation that crystallizes her impossible social position.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Secret and the System: Lady Dedlock's Impossible Position
curation_assignments.rationale: Lady Dedlock's recognition of Hawdon's handwriting at Chesney Wold is the foundational plot-revelation moment that sets her secret in motion.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Secret and the System: Lady Dedlock's Impossible Position
curation_assignments.rationale: Lady Dedlock frozen in profile as her secret is read aloud by firelight is one of the novel's most cinematically powerful revelation moments.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Secret and the System: Lady Dedlock's Impossible Position
curation_assignments.rationale: Lady Dedlock maintaining her dominant social performance while her secret erodes her confidence shows the impossible dual existence she inhabits.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Secret and the System: Lady Dedlock's Impossible Position
curation_assignments.rationale: The closing account of Lady Dedlock buried in the family mausoleum with the truth suppressed by Sir Leicester completes her tragic arc.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's Voice and Silence: The Cost of Being Unseen
curation_assignments.rationale: Jo's death described as a cart shaken to pieces on a rugged road is a concentrated narrative technique achievement—poetic, restrained, devastating.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Bleak House and the Architecture of Hope: Why Dickens Earned His Ending
curation_assignments.rationale: The decaying, ghost-haunted Chesney Wold in autumn provides a thematic counterpoint to Bleak House's domestic warmth for the closing discussion of hope.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Bleak House and the Architecture of Hope: Why Dickens Earned His Ending
curation_assignments.rationale: The revelation that Woodcourt's new home is named Bleak House—a second beginning—is the novel's most resonant act of structural hope.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Bleak House and the Architecture of Hope: Why Dickens Earned His Ending
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's retrospective meditation on her journey from solitary childhood to Bleak House provides thematic closure on identity and belonging.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Chancellery Grinds: Class, Law, and Extraction
curation_assignments.rationale: The rhetorical question connecting the Dedlock world to Jo's marginal existence reveals the novel's systemic social web as a structural complement.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the Machine: Dickens' Opening Gambit
curation_assignments.rationale: The catalogue of corruption Jarndyce and Jarndyce has spread through all adjacent parties establishes the thematic frame for the whole episode.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Bleak House and the Architecture of Hope: Why Dickens Earned His Ending
curation_assignments.rationale: The moonlit pastoral panorama ending with Chancery pipes that have no stop offers thematic synthesis of nature, law, and futility for the closing segment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Chancellery Grinds: Class, Law, and Extraction
curation_assignments.rationale: Jo's revelation to Snagsby of the mysterious lady who paid him is a plot-advancement pivot connecting the Dedlock and Chancery worlds structurally.
